# docstube

> Verified docs, generated from your code.

## Docs
- [CLI reference](/cli-reference/): Command syntax and flags for the docstube CLI.
- [Configuration](/configuration/): Configure docstube.yml, ia.yml, glossary.yaml, agents, locales, components, and plugins.
- [Getting started](/getting-started/): Install docstube, open the setup wizard, and generate the first verified docs site.
- [CI and the GitHub Action](/github-action/): How the docstube GitHub Action runs generation, reports verified changes, and gates auto-merge.
- [How verification works](/how-verification-works/): How docstube turns writer claims into anchored, checked, unchecked, or contradicted documentation states.
- [Writing plugins](/writing-plugins/): Create and load docstube plugins with @docstube/plugin-sdk.
